camel_example: aliyun esa ListUserRatePlanInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Status online --PageSize 500 --PageNumber 1 --InstanceId 'sp-xcdn-96wblslz0000' --SortBy CreateTime --SubscribeType basicplan --PlanType enterprise --PlanNameEn entranceplan --SortOrder asc --RemainingExpireDays 30 --CheckRemainingSiteQuota true
description_en: Queries the plan instances purchased by the user and their details
description_zh: 查询该用户已购买的套餐实例及其详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-user-rate-plan-instances --check-remaining-site-quota true --status online --sort-by CreateTime --sort-order asc --page-number 1 --page-size 500 --instance-id sp-xcdn-96wblslz0000 --remaining-expire-days 30 --subscribe-type basicplan --plan-type enterprise --plan-name-en entranceplan --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUserRatePlanInstances

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to filter plan instances that have remaining site quota. Valid values:

- **true**: Filters plan instances that have remaining site quota.
- **false**: Queries all plan instances under the user
parameters.help_zh:
是否筛选有剩余站点配额的套餐实例。支持：

- **true**：筛选有剩余站点配额的套餐实例。
- **false**：查询用户下所有的套餐实例
parameters.name: check_remaining_site_quota

parameters.help_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
- **online**: The plan instance is in normal service.
- **offline**: The plan instance has expired but has not exceeded the grace period and is not active.
- **disable**: The plan instance has been released.
- **overdue**: The plan instance has an overdue payment
parameters.help_zh:
套餐实例状态。支持：
- **online**：正常服务状态。
- **offline**：到期但未超期，处于不可用的状态。
- **disable**：已释放状态。
- **overdue**：欠费状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort the results. By default, results are sorted by purchase time. Valid values:

- **CreateTime**: purchase time.
- **ExpireTime**: expiration time
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，默认按照新购时间排序。支持：

- **CreateTime**：新购时间。
- **ExpireTime**：到期时间
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Default value: desc. Valid values:

- **asc**: ascending order.
- **desc**: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序标识，默认为降序。支持：

- **asc**：升序。
- **desc**：降序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The page number to return in a paged query. Default value: **1**. Valid values: **1** to **100000**. Settings for paging take effect only when this parameter is specified
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。默认值为**1**。取值范围为：**1~100000**
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500. This parameter is used for paging
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The plan instance ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 套餐实例ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Queries plan instances whose remaining validity period is within the specified number of days. The value must be a positive integer. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh: 查询套餐有效期剩余天数在指定天数以内的套餐实例，只能为正整数，单位为天
parameters.name: remaining_expire_days

parameters.help_en:
The plan subscription type. Valid values:

- entranceplan: Free Edition (Chinese mainland)
- entranceplan_intl: Free Edition (International)
- basicplan: Basic Edition
- standardplan: Standard Edition
- advancedplan: Premium Edition
- enterpriseplan: Enterprise Edition
parameters.help_zh:
套餐订阅类型。取值范围：

- 免费版（国内）：entranceplan
- 免费版（国际）：entranceplan_intl
- 基础版：basicplan
- 标准版：standardplan
- 高级版：advancedplan
- 企业版：enterpriseplan
parameters.name: subscribe_type

parameters.help_en:
The plan type. Valid values:

- normal: fixed-version plan
- enterprise: Enterprise Edition plan
parameters.help_zh:
套餐类型。取值范围:

- normal: 固定版套餐
- enterprise: 企业版套餐
parameters.name: plan_type
